A1.justification: Both complete, readable 75-page PDFs describe the same survey. The text, equations, figures, tables, and references support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: Figure 1 in v2.pdf reports the authors’ bibliometric analysis of cumulative publication counts from Semantic Scholar keyword searches covering 2022–February 2025. This qualifies as original data-analysis results.

after.justification: Figure 1 in v4.pdf retains the same original publication-count analysis. Retained data-analysis outcomes qualify even though the rest of the paper primarily surveys prior research.

M1.justification: Sections 2–5 retain the same reasoning framework and descriptions of algorithms, model components, training objectives, and inference procedures. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Figure 1 retains the same publication population, categories, and 2022–February 2025 coverage. No training or evaluation dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Neither version reports an original head-to-head model-comparison experiment. The methods and comparisons summarized from prior research are unchanged.

E3.justification: Figure 1 retains the same Semantic Scholar keyword-search basis and cumulative-count reporting. No analysis protocol, evaluation metric, or experimental setting is revised.

E4.justification: No ablation, robustness test, sensitivity analysis, or case study is added or removed. Section 6.2.2 retains the same discussion of prior empirical analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated runs, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for its publication-count analysis. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Figure 1’s plotted counts and trends are unchanged. Numerical examples, performance statements attributed to prior work, and qualitative findings also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The MDP definitions, Equations 1–13, and discussion of theoretical analyses retain the same mathematical content. No assumption, derivation, or proof is added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: organizing reasoning by regimes and architectures, unifying input/output perspectives, and identifying trends and challenges.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations remain unchanged, including verifier failures, refinement risks, reasoning-evaluation difficulties, generalization concerns, and data challenges.

D1.justification: Technical descriptions, data-collection information, and resource-access information are unchanged. No implementation detail or reproducibility resource is added, removed, or revised.

R1.justification: Section 1.5 retains the same positioning relative to earlier surveys. The cited works and bibliography are unchanged.

P1.justification: The title page updates Chengwei Qin’s affiliation from Nanyang Technological University to HKUST (Guangzhou), with a corresponding email and affiliation-marker change. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The updated affiliation expands the title-page institutional block from two lines to three and slightly shifts the abstract. Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–8 retain their content, structure, and placement.

improvement.justification: v4.pdf updates author information and makes small title-page layout adjustments while preserving the scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations, and references. These administrative and presentation edits do not produce a meaningful overall quality difference.
